---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

### Use case

Why does this matter? Describe the real-world scenario or program that
would benefit from this feature. Concrete examples ("I was trying to do
X and ran into Y") are far more useful than abstract requests.

### Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. If it's an API, sketch the function signature or
example call site. If it's a CLI flag or tooling change, describe the
intended behavior.

### Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you didn't pick them.
Workarounds you're using today, if any.

### Additional context

Links to similar features in other languages, related issues, sketches,
benchmarks — anything that helps reviewers understand the shape of the
problem.
